rows.explanation: C15. Students with dyslexia and other language-based learning disabilities (LBLDs) face enormous challenges, starting with the inconsistent and inequitable frequency of testing to diagnose and assess these learning differences, and continuing with inconsistent and inequitable availability of facilities, curriculum and appropriately experienced staff to meet those needs. A new high school is needed in our District that is equipped and staffed to meet those needs, without displacing other currently situated students or needs.
